subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N20 across all 14 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N20 is one of the broadest-application engines we work on — the same base engine across 14 model lines, spanning saloons, SUVs, a roadster and now a hybrid SUV flagship.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with hybrid-system ancillaries additionally accounted for on MHEV/PHEV applications.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the N20 across any of its 14 applications. That's a genuinely different situation from several other engines in our network where a specific wear pattern is well-documented — for the N20, we don't have one to report, and we won't invent one to sound more thorough.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed N20 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
